integrity: An exact transform and self-contained analytic saddle proof support the theorem; finite script checks are corroborative, not proof. One plausible source was accessible by abstract only.
scientific_limitations: Finite critical drift squared per horizon, fixed initial point, fixed observation windows, hard quadratic budget; no growing-window, infinite-horizon TV, or arbitrary potential extension.
title: Critical square-root drift changes the confinement rate of conditioned Brownian motion
